title: Sean McVay: I'd love to have Kirk Cousins if things don't work out with Jimmy Garoppolo

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: I'd love to have Kirk Cousins if things don't work out with Jimmy Garoppolo
sources.description: Sean McVay and Kirk Cousins worked together in Washington 10 years ago and McVay wouldn't mind it if things work out for the two of them to work together again in Los Angeles.
